note: Family-run RV park within the town of Lamont, about 7 minutes from Elk Island National Park, with grass sites, picnic tables and fire pits, a playground and propane. It sells nights alongside weekly, monthly, seasonal and winter stays and markets to work and union crews; only the sites around the house stay open in winter. Units built before 2010 need management approval. --Claude
summary: Fees base corrected C$40->C$50 (the C$40 sites are 20 A power-only capped at 4 nights) with extra-person rule; 50 A, 72 campsites (was 75), max 50 ft, Let's Camp booking, year-round confirmed; long-stay tests pass.
flags: Phone correction: stored 780-895-2220 appears nowhere; operator site, Let's Camp and Google all give 780-826-0078 (Google listing 4504 49a St, Lamont).

Price gate PASS: base C$50 (30 A full-service, operator page + Let's Camp startingNightlyRate). The cheaper C$40 20 A power-only sites 16-19 are capped at 4 nights 'unless approved by management', so they were not used as the base.

Long-stay tests (park markets short-term, long-term, seasonal, winter, 'workers, and union crews'): (1) C$50 <= C$69 pass; (2) nightly rates posted on its own site with phone and Let's Camp sells one night (minNights 1) pass. Caveat for the reviewer: 'Units made before 2010 require management approval. No derelict units — photos must be provided.' — read as applying to pre-2010 units; a 2023 rig is unaffected. (3) no minimum over 2 nights pass; (4) occupancy: one-night search for 2 adults returned 58 of 72 campsites open on Tue 2027-06-08 and on 2027-06-15, and 6 open (winter sites) on Tue 2026-11-17 pass; (5) not a home community pass. Recommend keep.
Site count: Let's Camp lists 94 units = 72 campsites + 22 storage spots; stored 75 replaced with 72.
Waterfront: not waterfront, no water nearby.
